title: The room Japanese companies send you to instead of firing you
chunks: and a man in the corner
has someone else's photos on it.
so you put your feet up too.
and wait for you to leave.

beats.picture: office wide: the boss puts a hand on Ken's shoulder at his desk
beats.walking: the boss walks Ken down the aisle past the busy desks
beats.room: the plain grey door at the end opens onto a tiny bare room
beats.computer: insert: an empty desk, a pale dust outline where a monitor used to be
beats.work: insert: an empty in-tray, an empty drawer slides open
beats.clock: the 3D wall clock ticks, second hand jumps
beats.corner: pan to the corner: Taro in a red cardigan
beats.feet: Taro's feet are up on his desk, he scrolls his phone
beats.nothing: the boss opens his hands: nothing; Ken's jaw drops
beats.six: the boss taps his watch and points at the clock; the hour hand on six
beats.holiday: Ken stretches in the sunbeam, closed-eye smile, sparkles
beats.staring: Ken walks past the office; heads turn one by one to stare
beats.emails: close-up of his phone: the stack of mail bars shrinks to none
beats.photos: a stranger's family photo frame now sits on it
beats.friday: the door opens: the boss leans in
beats.smiling: the boss's huge grin and thumbs-up
beats.enjoying: Ken forces a smile; cut, the boss leans in again (another week)
beats.years: insert: Taro's desk with a huge cactus and a tall stack of finished puzzle books
beats.feet2: Ken puts his feet up next to Taro, both relaxed
beats.monday: cool morning light, Ken walks in
beats.cleared: push-in: his desk is bare; Ken's face drains pale blue
beats.japan: aerial: a city block of office towers
beats.firing: cutaway: the boss tries to push a pink slip through a slot with two big padlocks
beats.hard: the slip bounces back; the boss scratches his head
beats.takeaway: high-angle insert: Ken's desk items slide away one by one
beats.wait: the boss sits outside the room glancing at his watch, the clock hands spin
beats.leave: Ken walks out of the room with a cardboard box
beats.chaseout: wide: the door of the tiny room closes; the office around it
beats.subscribe: back to the office wide: Ken at his desk looks up at the button
beats.strange: the cursor clicks, the button turns grey
beats.this: the bell rings, then the shot returns to frame 0
